description: Takes a loan amount, annual rate and tenure and returns how the EMI and total interest change when the rate moves up or down by small steps. Example input: {"principal":5000000,"annualRate":8.5,"years":20}

annualRate.description: Annual interest rate in percent, for example 8.5

deltas.description: Rate changes in percentage points to test, for example [-1, -0.5, 0.5, 1]

months.description: Loan tenure in months (6 to 480). Give months or years.

years.description: Loan tenure in years (0.5 to 40). Give months or years.

name: sensitivity
